title: 1952 Ellis & Shaw Grocers, purchased in 1946 from Frank Camp
description: In the 1930s, Frank Camp ran a meat market on the street level of what was once the Commercial Hotel, a large building beside the railroad tracks, with warehouses behind the storefront. Gerald Shaw worked part-time at Camp’s Market. After returning from the war, Shaw and his friend, Leighton Ellis, bought the store and renamed it 'Ellis and Shaw,' expanding the business to include groceries as well as meat. They operated the store until 1966. This photo was taken in 1952. (Courtesy of Necedah Shaw Fairgrieves)
